name: Removed File manager — previous results kept

cases.title: Try this tool step by step
cases.need: Test pack: small/ folder; no USB needed.
cases.why: Checks that copying, renaming and deleting affect only the chosen test files.
steps: Open Android Files. Extract USB-Test-Files.zip in Downloads. Keep the original extracted folder unchanged; use copies for editing.
In USB Workbench, open Home → File manager. Choose the small folder inside USB-Test-Files and allow access.
Open hello.txt. It must say: USB Workbench manual test. Go back and copy it to a new folder called TestOutput.
Rename ONLY the copied file to renamed.txt. Open it again; the words must be unchanged.
Delete ONLY renamed.txt, read the confirmation and confirm. Return to the original small folder: hello.txt must still exist.
cases.expected: Copied file opens correctly; rename works; delete removes only the copy; the original stays unchanged.

cases.title: Tool-specific scenario 1
cases.steps: Create nestedtestfolders; copy/open/rename/delete onlyownedfiles. Test traversal, revokedgrant, missingfile and source=destination.
cases.expected: Record exact inputs, independent comparison, output and any defect. Pass only when the stated behavior and published limits are confirmed.

cases.title: Normal supported workflow
cases.steps: Read the tool's supported scope below. Follow: Choose the phone or USB location in Android’s picker and allow access to the intended folder. → Open folders to inspect files. Use the file actions for copy, rename, checksum or delete. → Check the destination before copying. Read delete confirmations carefully; deletion has no undo here.. Use only owned fixtures/spares and independently compare the result.
cases.expected: The observed result matches: Files saved in the folder you chose. If Android cannot show an NTFS/ext USB, try the separate direct read-only browser.

cases.title: Invalid input / permission / capacity
cases.steps: Try a truncated or unsupported source, denied permission, missing target, and insufficient destination space as applicable. Preserve hashes of all originals.
cases.expected: Clear, localized refusal; no unrelated edits/deletes, no crash and no false success.

cases.title: Cancel and recover
cases.steps: Cancel during each reachable phase using disposable media/owned outputs. Reopen Activity/details and retry only after completion with a newly reviewed target.
cases.expected: No duplicate jobs, automatic retry, unrelated cleanup, stale target write or false completion. Record any partial output.

cases.title: Arabic / English / accessibility
cases.steps: Open this tool in both languages; enlargefont; inspect controls/options/warnings/progress/results on phone andtablet withTalkBack.
cases.expected: Readable text, correctRTL, usable controls and consistent selected-language reports.

scope: Use Android’s storage picker to grant access to one folder. Browse subfolders, copy multiple files, rename, delete and calculate SHA-256. Filesystem support depends on Android and the storage provider. NTFS/ext drives that Android cannot mount need a separate driver, which is not bundled. Existing names are never overwritten during copy.

امنح الوصول لمجلد عبر منتقي تخزين أندرويد. تصفح المجلدات الفرعية وانسخ عدة ملفات وأعد تسميتها واحذفها واحسب SHA-256. دعم أنظمة الملفات يعتمد على أندرويد ومزوّد التخزين. وحدات NTFS/ext التي لا يقرأها أندرويد تحتاج محركاً منفصلاً غير مضمن. النسخ لا يستبدل ملفات تحمل الاسم نفسه.
impact: Browsing reads files; copy/rename/delete can change the selected folder. Deletion is permanent.
التصفح يقرأ الملفات؛ النسخ والتسمية والحذف قد تغيّر المجلد. الحذف نهائي.
